outcome: Characteristics of women undergoing induced abortion
Ratio of induced abortions to live births
Rate of induced abortions among specific subgroups
cohort: Women who underwent induced abortions (n = 19,655) at the Xiamen Maternity and Child Health Care Hospital between 2010 and 2013
finding: While the overall ratio of induced abortions to live births decreased in China between 2010 and 2013, the rate of induced abortions increased among certain subgroups, including lactating women and those with a history of caesarean section.
mod_finding: The study found an increase in induced abortions among women who had a history of caesarean section.
